name: @orbb/platform
description: Deployment adapter interfaces and environment matrix for ORBB (architecture provider map): WebHost, HttpRuntime, EventBus/JobRunner, ObjectStore, SqlStore, Cache/RateLimiter — plus the device-source health seam (Lane C packet M4-C, A32/A34/A35): MeasurementSourceRegistry, DeviceSourceAdapter, HealthKit/Health Connect TypeScript seams with synthetic native doubles, and the M4 exit harness scaffolding. Pure TypeScript over the frozen @orbb/domain contracts and the @orbb/observability logger — no provider SDK imports, workspace dependencies only. In-memory reference implementations exist ONLY for Cache/RateLimiter (test use) and the health-seam doubles.
